title: Free recipe keeper and meal planner — no subscription, no account
description: Keep as many recipes as you like, plan the week and get the shopping list added up across every meal. Paste a recipe in and it separates the ingredients from the method. Scale any recipe to the number of people you are cooking for. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded, and there is no cap and no subscription. A free alternative to ReciMe and the recipe apps that charge yearly.
